subject: Title IX Sexual Discrimination Grievance Procedure
overview: The School Committee conducted a detailed review and approved the first reading of a comprehensive Title IX sexual discrimination grievance procedure. The updated policy incorporates revised federal guidelines regarding reporting, investigations, and emergency removals.

items.title: Title IX Sexual Discrimination Grievance Procedure
items.summary: Approved the first reading of Resolution 2024-38, establishing an 18-page procedure for handling sexual discrimination and harassment complaints in compliance with updated federal regulations. The committee discussed specific provisions regarding group investigations, evidence redaction, and the designation of staff roles for the appeals process.
